description_en: Queries the details of a specified time template
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定时间模板的详情信息
name: QueryTimeTemplateDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the time template. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107890.html to query the ID
parameters.name: template_id

Code.description_en:
The response code of the operation.

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Data.description_en: The time template information returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回时间模板信息

AllDay.description_en:
Indicates whether 24/7 recording is enabled.

1: Yes.
0: No. For detailed configurations, see the TimeSectionList parameter
AllDay.description_zh:
是否7天*24小时录像：

1：是。
0：否，详细配置请查看TimeSectionList参数

Default.description_en:
Indicates whether this is the default template.

1: Default template.
0: Custom template
Default.description_zh:
是否是默认模板：

1：默认模板。
0：自定义模板

Name.description_en: The name of the time template

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the time template

Begin.description_en: The start time of each day, in seconds
Begin.description_zh: 每天开始的时间，单位为秒

DayOfWeek.description_en: The day of the week. Valid values: 0 to 6, which represent Sunday through Saturday
DayOfWeek.description_zh: 时间。取值0~6，表示周日~周六

End.description_en: The end time of each day, in seconds
End.description_zh: 每天结束的时间，单位为秒

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
